name: Collado de la Vera (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of green, white, red, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Collado (a saint between trees on green above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Collado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Collado arms — saint between trees above waves
